typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features a strong contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and relatively flat, horizontal serifs. These characteristics are typical of the "Modern" or Didone style (like Bodoni or Didot), which evolved from Transitional styles to create a more structured, high-contrast appearance common in formal 18th and 19th-century printing.
